name: agent-kit
description: The kit's plugins for Claude Code; the kit gives them to its sessions with --plugin-dir.

plugins.name: agent-kit
plugins.description: The rules every session and subagent of the kit starts with, the gate owner-run, and the skills every kind of work needs.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Architecture, development and deploy: writing and changing code, the structure of an application and of a system, the decisions, what runs and where.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: How a thing looks and how an interface works.

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: Quality assurance: testing a product as a user would and reporting each finding; the session changes no file of the project.

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Planning in OpenSpec: the agent spec works a change out and writes no code; a hook keeps its writing under openspec/.

plugins.name: openspec
plugins.description: OpenSpec for a project: its program, downloaded at the first call, and its skills to propose, apply, update, sync and archive a change.

plugins.name: toolsmith
plugins.description: Work on the kit itself and on the configuration of Claude Code: where each thing is set.
